title: Manifest
description: Lists every published file of one patch with its hash. Published at /{patch}/manifest.json and signed by /{patch}/manifest.json.minisig (see contracts/README.md).

schemaVersion.description: Contract major version. A breaking change publishes a new version alongside this one.

generatedAt.description: UTC time the manifest was written (RFC 3339).

runId.description: Pipeline run that produced the files.

keyId.description: Minisign key id of the signing key, upper-case hex.

path.description: Path relative to the patch directory, '/'-separated; no segment starts with '.', so '.' and '..' are impossible.
